video_title: 2026-27 Media Day Press Conference 🎙️ | VJ Edgecombe

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe is focusing on improving his shooting, finishing, and dribbling this offseason.
quotes.excerpt: I have been working on my game. Shooting, finishing, dribbling, everything.
quotes.quote: I have been countless reps shooting the ball. I say that is important, especially now with the team that we have now. Just trying to pick my spaces, pick my times, but I have been working on my game. Shooting, finishing, dribbling, everything. I have just been trying to get better.
quotes.social_post: VJ Edgecombe says he is focusing on his all-around game this offseason, specifically working on his shooting, finishing, and dribbling to get better.

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe says he takes pride in playing defense and finds it fun.
quotes.excerpt: I take pride in playing defense. I just find it fun
quotes.quote: I take pride in playing defense. I just find it fun when it is kind of hard for the opposing team to score. I find that I find that kind of fun. I enjoy I enjoy playing defense and I feel like it gets me going, it gets me hype, and also just gets the team going also.
quotes.social_post: VJ Edgecombe says he takes pride in playing defense and finds it fun when it is hard for the opposing team to score.

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe initiated a group chat with his new teammates but did not have LeBron James' number.
quotes.excerpt: I told Tyrese first, initially, before LeBron got there. I was like, I want to make a group chat
quotes.quote: I told Tyrese first, initially, before LeBron got there. I was like, I want to make a group chat, me, Tyrese, Jalen, Joel. And then LeBron came and obviously I do not have LeBron James number. So I cannot say go add LeBron to a group chat. Plus, if I had his number, I would not randomly add LeBron to a group chat. You get what I am saying? So I told Tyrese to do it. I asked Tyrese if we could do it.
quotes.social_post: VJ Edgecombe says he started a group chat with his new teammates but did not have LeBron James' number to add him to it.

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe admits he was surprised by how tired he was after his rookie season.
quotes.excerpt: First of all, the NBA you get really tired.
quotes.quote: First of all, the NBA you get really tired. So when I was able to take some weeks off and like you say reflect on on the season, I was first of all I was really tired. I do not know if that is normal, but yeah.
quotes.social_post: VJ Edgecombe says he was surprised by how tired he was after his rookie season in the NBA.
